item.title: [LU-20843] autotest: ostcount= is per-OSS but mdtcount= is total in Test-Parameters
item.description:
The Test-Parameters "ostcount=" and "mdtcount=" options are interpreted inconsistently by autotest: ostcount is the number of OSTs per OSS, while mdtcount is the total number of MDTs across all MDS nodes. This makes it easy to request the wrong configuration.

Evidence:

  • https://review.whamcloud.com/69271 patchset 2 used "Test-Parameters: osscount=2 ostcount=12 testlist=sanity" (and testlist=ost-pools). The custom sessions ran with 24 OSTs (lustre-OST0000 .. lustre-OST0017), 12 on each OSS:
    • https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/173662d5-e12b-427e-8bd7-1b5f348ca9cc
    • https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/c4fd9851-b86a-4261-af6d-4ab6bffddb91
  • https://review.whamcloud.com/56384 patchset 36 used "Test-Parameters: testlist=sanity mdscount=6 mdtcount=24". The custom session ran with 24 MDTs total (lustre-MDT0000 .. lustre-MDT0017), not 24 per MDS:
    • https://testing.whamcloud.com/test_sessions/45f3fac5-47b3-4a00-94dd-a5c7eb5ea69a

So "osscount=2 ostcount=12" gives 24 OSTs, but "mdscount=2 mdtcount=12" gives 12 MDTs.

Both options should use the same meaning. Since mdtcount= already means the total, and the default review-dne sessions describe the configuration as total counts, it would be least surprising for ostcount= to also be the total number of OSTs, spread across the osscount= OSS nodes. If that is not practical, please document the per-node meaning of ostcount= wherever the Test-Parameters options are described.
item.summary: autotest: ostcount= is per-OSS but mdtcount= is total in Test-Parameters

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment: I checked the few other sessions that request multiple OSS nodes with `message:osscount= -message:osscount=1` to find any that use 2 or more. This confirmed that `osscount=2 ostcount=2` actually created 4 OSTs (2 per OSS), unlike the `mdscount=2 mdtcount=12` that created 12 MDTs.

Although I agree, this has historically been the behavior (since before my time). The wiki does specify mdtcount as "The total number of MDTs spread across all of the MDSs." and ostcount as "The number of OSTs per OSS."

https://wiki.whamcloud.com/spaces/PUB/pages/8552564/Changing+Test+Parameters+with+Gerrit+Commit+Messages

Changing the behavior will require some temporary AT code to use the previous ostcount behavior for older patches.

I checked with the above search parameters, and there are very few patches that ever specify anything other than osscount=1 to match the default Autotest config, so changing the behavior for osscount=2+

It looks like there are only 4 patches open of interest using osscount=2, mine, one test patch, and two patches that are just trying > 1 OSS (with ostcount=2 or not specifying ostcount= at all). There are a handful of older patches (2017-2025, but all dated "2025" due to spurious checkpatch runs) so I don't think there is any real concern about affecting old behavior. If osscount=N ostcount=1 is used, then there should still be a minimum of 1 OST per OSS.

Deployed 10/03/2026
ostcount is now the total number of OSTs to distribute across the OSSs

I can't edit the test-parameters wiki, will check with DCO on Monday
